answer: A workable defense is a refundable reputation bond tied to endorsements. Each agent locks a bond before it may vouch for others, and the bond is slashed if a vouched identity is later proven fake, so a whisper of fraud in the cluster costs its sponsors real money. Endorsements decay unless renewed by verifiable work, which stops an attacker buying one sable badge of trust and reusing it forever. Because penalties ripple outward to every sponsor of a bad identity, creating thousands of sock puppets means funding thousands of bonds and risking them all, while an honest agent risks only one.
